messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.6.2

1.6.2. Access to operating positions and servicing points Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow access in safety to all areas where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment, maintenance and cleaning of the machinery or related product. In the case of machinery or related products into which persons shall enter for operation, adjustment, maintenance or cleaning, the machinery accesses shall be dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment in such a way that an emergency rescue of the persons is possible.

Machinery or related products | shall be designed and constructed | to allow access in safety to all areas where intervention is necessary | during operation, adjustment, maintenance and cleaning of the machinery or related product | Machinery or related products shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to allow access in safety to all areas where intervention is necessary during operation, adjustment, maintenance and cleaning of the machinery or related product.
Machinery accesses | shall be dimensioned and adapted | for the use of rescue equipment | in the case of machinery into which persons shall enter for operation, adjustment, maintenance or cleaning | the machinery accesses shall be dimensioned and adapted for the use of rescue equipment
Machinery accesses | shall make possible | emergency rescue of persons | in the case of machinery into which persons shall enter for operation, adjustment, maintenance or cleaning | in such a way that an emergency rescue of the persons is possible
